creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-27, 2026-11-22
authorization: Owner told the orchestrator on 2026-11-22 to use the remaining PixelLab credits today; same-day exception to the retirement rule.
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom body template because a bird fits no skeleton, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 31) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames come back on 40-44 px canvases, centred on 32x32 without scaling). v3 only makes even frame counts, so idle keeps frames 0-2 of 4 and telegraph keeps frames 1-3 of 4; dropped frames are not shipped. All four facings are separate generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Cinder heron, a small chibi wading bird with a large round head, charcoal-grey feathers with glowing orange ember tips on the wings and crest, a long sharp pale yellow beak, two long thin dark stilt legs, a long S-curved neck folded down, a tall spiky ember-orange head crest. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands on its long legs and bobs its head slowly, ember crest flickering, wing feathers glowing faintly

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, stands still and bobs its head slightly, crest flickering
direction_prompts.west: facing left, stands on its long legs and bobs its head slowly, crest flickering
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, stands still and bobs its head slightly, crest flickering
direction_prompts.east: facing right, stands on its long legs and bobs its head slowly, crest flickering

walk.action_description: strides forward on its long thin legs in a high-stepping wading walk, head bobbing, crest flickering

direction_prompts.south: walks toward the viewer lifting its long legs high, head bobbing
direction_prompts.west: walks to the left lifting its long legs high, head bobbing forward
direction_prompts.north: walks away from the viewer seen from behind, lifting its long legs
direction_prompts.east: walks to the right lifting its long legs high, head bobbing forward

telegraph.action_description: draws its neck back into a tight S-curve and spreads both wings wide open, crest flaring tall and glowing bright, beak aimed forward, before a stab

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, draws its neck back and spreads both wings wide, crest flaring tall
direction_prompts.west: facing left, draws its neck back into an S-curve and spreads its wings, beak pointing left
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, spreads both wings wide and flares the crest
direction_prompts.east: facing right, draws its neck back into an S-curve and spreads its wings, beak pointing right

strike.action_description: stabs its long beak forward fast with its neck snapping out straight, wings flaring, then pulls back to standing

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, snaps its neck and beak forward toward the viewer, then pulls back
direction_prompts.west: facing left, snaps its neck and beak out straight to the left, then pulls back
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, snaps its neck forward away from the viewer, wings flaring, then pulls back
direction_prompts.east: facing right, snaps its neck and beak out straight to the right, then pulls back

attempts.what: idle, walk, telegraph, strike v3 for south/west/north/east, 4 clips x 4 directions
attempts.result: accepted with flags; no regeneration spent (left for the human review)

known_flaws: south and north read as a thin humanoid column with wing-arms rather than a bird; the beak and legs carry the heron in west and east only
south crest is hard to see at 1x in several frames
idle and telegraph were generated with 4 frames and trimmed to the profile's 3
